verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document a built-in AI assistant inside Anytype that answers questions, summarizes, or drafts from the user's notes. What it does show is the Local API, an official MCP server, and an Agents Skill that let external tools such as Claude Code or Cursor read and modify Anytype data. These are integration building blocks for third-party assistants, not an in-app assistant with data-visibility controls, so they earn no credit for this story.
